verdict.rationale: Stable has a real API, but its own docs limit it to searching and retrieving MailItems, creating and onboarding Locations, and some Company endpoints. Most dashboard capabilities have no documented API equivalent: mail actions (scan, ship, shred, deposit), tags, team and user assignments, roles, and routing. Webhook endpoints and API keys are configured only in the dashboard, so the API is a narrow subset of the UI rather than full parity. Missing for 10: API coverage of mail actions (scan/ship/shred/deposit), tagging and assignment, roles and permissions, auto-routing rules, programmatic webhook and API-key management, and a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404).
